verified_facts.text: The resort sits on a five-mile-long barrier island, minutes from downtown Miami.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on an exclusive five-mile-long barrier island, The Ritz-Carlton Key Biscayne, Miami is just minutes from dynamic downtown yet offers an atmosphere of sequestered serenity.

verified_facts.text: A $100 million renovation was completed throughout 2025, led by developer Gencom with design studios Hart Howerton, DesignAgency and Chapi Chapo Design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enter a $100 million transformation completed throughout 2025, led by global luxury developer Gencom in collaboration with design studios Hart Howerton, DesignAgency, and Chapi Chapo Design.

verified_facts.text: The resort reopened in December 2025 after the renovation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Following its December 2025 reopening, many longtime staff members returned, joined by new faces energized by the property's next chapter.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have been nearly completely redone with light woods, golden fixtures and floor-to-ceiling windows or sliding glass doors opening to the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guest rooms and suites have been nearly completely redone, corner to corner, and brought into a modern design vernacular.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have gold-veined marble, deep soaking tubs, separate showers and Diptyque bath products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bathrooms are generous, finished in gold-veined marble, with deep soaking tubs, separate showers, and Diptyque bath products.

verified_facts.text: Every accommodation has a balcony with ocean, island or resort views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Balconies with ocean, island, or resort views, along with spacious, light‑filled layouts, are signature features of every accommodation at The Ritz‑Carlton Key Biscayne, Miami.

verified_facts.text: Luma is an Italian grill with house-made pastas and proteins from a Josper oven, and it is the resort's signature restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luma, an Italian grill where house-made pastas share the spotlight with well-composed proteins from the Josper oven, anchors the dining program as the resort's signature restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Paralia, by the beach, serves Aegean-inspired dishes meant for sharing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Out by the beach, Paralía, open for both lunch and dinner, focuses on Aegean-inspired dishes meant for sharing, from traditional hot and cold meze and Greek village salad to more inventive touches like savory baklava.

verified_facts.text: Dune Beach Bar is a no-reservations, toes-in-the-sand lounge serving burgers and ceviches.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's a no-reservations, toes-in-the-sand lounge serving burgers and ceviches, with DJs spinning on weekends from early afternoon.

verified_facts.text: The resort has two oceanfront pools: an adult pool and a zero-entry family pool with a splash pad.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two Oceanfront Swimming Pools — Adult Pool and Zero‑Entry Family Pool with Splash Pad

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa has sixteen treatment rooms, including couples suites, a full-service salon and several restorative lounges including a spa garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sixteen treatment rooms, including couples suites, a full-service salon, and several restorative lounges—including a spa garden—form the core of the experience.

verified_facts.text: The Cliff Drysdale Racquet Garden offers tennis, padel and pickleball courts, and the resort has a long-standing connection to tennis.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tennis, pickleball, and padel courts at the Cliff Drysdale Tennis Center continue the property's long-standing connection to the sport

verified_facts.text: Ritz Kids sessions are available for resort guests ages 5 through 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sessions are available for resort guests ages 5 through 12, and each morning and afternoon session features curated activities inspired by life on a tropical oasis.

verified_facts.text: Key Biscayne is not the place for Miami nightlife or the South Beach scene; it suits guests who want resort life.
verified_facts.excerpt: If you're hoping to immerse yourself in Miami's nightlife or South Beach scene, I'd say this isn't the place to stay.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites do not have overhead lighting, so rooms can feel dark when there is no natural daylight.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms and suites still don't have overhead illumination, and during times without natural daylight, the rooms can feel dark.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service from Miami International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Miami International Airport Distance from Property: 15.0 Miles Phone Number: +1 305-871-4100 Learn More This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club costs extra, with a large Club Lounge serving food throughout the day and Club-level rooms on the ninth floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Club costs extra, but it's a smart splurge. Access comes with a large Club Lounge serving food throughout the day, a dedicated concierge, and Club-level rooms on the ninth floor.
